waveform.frame_placement: physical frame k begins at physical time k/750; its receiver-sample start is round(Fs*(1+ppm*1e-6)*k/750)
waveform.true_sample_clock_resampling: for every occupied frame, linearly interpolate real and imaginary template samples at physical-template coordinate (receiver_sample-receiver_frame_start)/(1+ppm*1e-6); carrier phase is evaluated at physical time receiver_time/(1+ppm*1e-6)
waveform.primary_alignment: oracle_true_resampled_frame_lattice, representing a successful upstream frame-alignment stage
waveform.secondary_alignment: nominal_fixed_3333_3334_lattice, diagnostic only and never promotion evidence
waveform.occupancy: exact-count rank of PCG64 uniforms seeded by scenario seed plus 10000000
waveform.snr_definition: occupied injected-frame mean power divided by full-span digest-verified real-background mean power

truth_coordinates.physical_cfo: f0 + rate*tau + acceleration*tau^2/2 + jerk*tau^3/6 plus the frozen CFO step
truth_coordinates.alias_event: known receiver-coordinate branch label, canonicalized before rate fitting

scenario_design.construction: replicate every exact design row once on each of the three backgrounds; scenario ID is F5-{background ordinal 1..3}-{row_id}; seed is 914000 + 12*(background ordinal-1) + row ordinal-1
scenario_design.split_rule: C rows calibrate grouped intervals and may not be scored; E rows are evaluation-only and may not tune multipliers or the curvature model

frame_evidence.coarse_seed: truth-quantized nearest 750 Hz receiver-coordinate CFO; acquisition yield is out of scope

estimators.identical_mask_rule: all compared estimators use the same even-supported training frames and the same predeclared non-overlapping evaluation endpoints

lean_curvature_500ms.regularization: none; weighted robust quadratic using only strict-past frames

interval_calibration.candidate_interval: grouped split-conformal multiplier applied to the unchanged fixed500 standard error
interval_calibration.calibration_score: within each calibration scenario, maximum over its predeclared non-overlapping endpoints of abs(endpoint receiver-rate error)/max(legacy_sigma,1 Hz/s)
interval_calibration.multiplier: finite-sample 95% split-conformal order statistic ceil((n+1)*0.95), capped at the maximum when the requested order exceeds n
interval_calibration.grouping_unit: whole scenario; no overlapping endpoint is treated as independent
interval_calibration.curvature_lag: endpoint truth is used, so trailing-linear acceleration/jerk lag is included in the grouped calibration score rather than hidden by comparison to a trailing-average truth
interval_calibration.fitting_scope: all calibration scenarios with no CFO step and at least two retained endpoints; one global multiplier, with per-background scores reported but not separately tuned

metrics.primary_scope: evaluation rows with cfo_step_hz=0, snr_db>=-12, frame_occupancy>=0.70, oracle_true_resampled_frame_lattice, and all three backgrounds represented
metrics.scenario_simultaneous_coverage: a scenario is covered only when every retained non-overlapping endpoint contains endpoint receiver-rate truth

promotion_gates.promotion_rule: fixed500 interval calibration passes only if every fixed500 gate passes; lean curvature remains unpromoted unless its separate RMSE-ratio gate passes on the identical primary mask

interpretation_limits: The experiment calibrates component-test rate error conditional on truth-quantized timing and carrier acquisition; it does not measure acquisition yield.

The three backgrounds are previously published POST-FIX hard nulls, not active-signal backgrounds; strong-but-contaminated means stronger injection over real receiver background, not a newly selected active interferer.
Oracle true-lattice alignment isolates rate-estimator behavior after successful frame alignment; nominal-lattice results are a frame-recovery sensitivity diagnostic.
Split-conformal coverage is finite-sample grouped calibration on this frozen design, not proof of coverage on satellites, receivers, or future captures.
Sample-clock, LNB drift, transmitter drift, and geometric Doppler remain separate downstream nuisance-identification problems.
